title: llms-full.txt must be no more than params.maxAgeHours old
untested_rationale: This exact id remains emitted by checkPresence() from a live HTTP response, so the operational rule has no catalog cases. The same 4-hour policy is now exercised without network by evaluateLlmsCoherence() against fixed response snapshots; tests/audit/llms-coherence.test.ts also asserts params.maxAgeHours equals LLMS_COHERENCE_THRESHOLDS.maxCompositionAgeMs, so changing either side cannot pass silently.

spec.name: llms.txt (llmstxt.org)
spec.normative_quote: llms-full.txt has no formal spec of its own. This threshold is a local operational buffer: the composer runs on a 30-minute EventBridge rate plus an event trigger, and four hours bounds both missed compositions and the three-hour last-known-good origin fallback. The portfolio's public edge and browser responses are no-store.
spec.note: conformance_testable is false; no external spec imposes this threshold.
spec.verification_note: clause n/a -- rule_class: operational. normative_quote is a self-authored statement about the ABSENCE of external spec coverage for this transport/fetch/presence condition; there is no external normative clause to transcribe or verify against a source.
